findings.description: Unsafe deserialization via pickle.loads in rich/style.py allows execution of arbitrary code if self._meta is controlled by an attacker.
findings.code_snippet: return {} if self._meta is None else cast(Dict[str, Any], loads(self._meta))
findings.reasoning: The property getter for Style.meta uses pickle.loads on self._meta. If self._meta can be influenced by an attacker (directly or indirectly), it is possible to trigger arbitrary code execution. No input sanitization or safe deserialization is applied.
